review_scope: Upstream documentation and project identity; not a code audit or runtime validation.

tools.name: Nmap
tools.use_case: Inventory ports and service versions in a scoped assessment.
tools.network: Sends probes directly to the selected hosts.
tools.limitation: Version guesses need confirmation; NSE scripts vary in behavior.

tools.name: ffuf
tools.use_case: Find routes and compare responses in the local web lab.
tools.network: Sends HTTP requests directly to the target.
tools.limitation: SPA fallback pages can produce false positives; calibrate filters.

tools.name: ZAP
tools.summary: Intercepting proxy and web security scanner.
tools.use_case: Review HTTP behavior and produce a baseline web report.
tools.network: Spidering sends requests; active scan modes send attack payloads.
tools.limitation: Baseline rules are passive, but crawling is network-active and findings require review.

tools.name: Nuclei
tools.use_case: Run reviewed, explicit templates against a lab or scoped asset.
tools.network: Templates can contact targets and out-of-band services; cloud upload is a separate feature.
tools.limitation: Template matches are leads. Review template code, requests, and external interactions.

tools.name: Metasploit Framework
tools.use_case: Study modules and reproduce a vulnerability in a disposable VM lab.
tools.network: Selected modules connect to targets; payloads may create sessions and change state.
tools.limitation: Module-specific effects differ. Use VM snapshots and document exact module options.

tools.name: sqlmap
tools.use_case: Validate SQL injection in an intentionally vulnerable application.
tools.network: Sends injection payloads to target endpoints.
tools.limitation: Tests can be intrusive; start with a single parameter and minimal settings. Clone-based installs may have no PATH command.

tools.name: mitmproxy
tools.use_case: Inspect requests from your own client or test application.
tools.network: Traffic passes through your proxy; TLS decryption requires client trust configuration.
tools.limitation: Use a dedicated test browser profile; remove the test CA when finished.

tools.name: Subfinder
tools.use_case: Expand domain leads before separately validating ownership and scope.
tools.network: Queries external providers; API keys and provider coverage vary.
tools.limitation: Discovered names are not proof of live services or common ownership.

tools.name: checkdmarc
tools.use_case: Create actionable email-domain configuration findings.
tools.network: Performs DNS lookups, including policy-related records.
tools.limitation: DNS configuration alone does not establish mail delivery or spoofing outcomes.

tools.name: Auto Archiver
tools.use_case: Keep archived evidence behind a research finding.
tools.network: Fetches URLs; configured storage and archivers can send data to third parties.
tools.limitation: Platform changes, login requirements, and deleted content limit coverage.

tools.name: CertGraph
tools.use_case: Explore domain relationships beyond a flat certificate-name list.
tools.network: Default collection connects to hosts; the crtsh driver uses CT records.
tools.limitation: Shared certificates require corroboration before inferring ownership.

tools.name: Octosuite
tools.use_case: Analyze repository, organization, and public activity relationships.
tools.network: Queries GitHub; authenticated requests identify the API account.
tools.limitation: Rate limits and visibility constraints affect completeness.

tools.name: Kronikier
tools.use_case: Trace changes in a company's archived public contact pages.
tools.network: Queries the Wayback Machine and uses local caches.
tools.limitation: Historical contacts may be obsolete; compare normalized phone numbers with raw text.

tools.name: Metawarc
tools.use_case: Index preserved archives for repeatable local analysis.
tools.network: Processes local archives; integrations can change exposure.
tools.limitation: Useful after evidence capture; extracted metadata does not verify a source's claims.

tools.name: Cert Spotter
tools.use_case: Watch for certificate issuance involving your domains.
tools.network: Reads public CT logs; configured notification hooks may send data elsewhere.
tools.limitation: Issuance is an observation, not proof of a live service or compromise.

tools.name: ASN
tools.use_case: Explain network ownership and routing context behind an address.
tools.network: Queries external routing, geolocation, and optional reputation services; modes vary.
tools.limitation: IP geolocation and reputation are approximate and can be stale.

tools.name: ShadowFinder
tools.use_case: Compare possible locations using measured shadows and time.
tools.network: Notebook and map dependencies can access external services.
tools.limitation: Measurement and timestamp uncertainty can produce broad or wrong location estimates.

tools.name: PCAPdroid
tools.use_case: See which destinations your Android apps contact and export PCAPs.
tools.network: Normal capture processes traffic on the device using Android's VPN interface.
tools.limitation: Competes with another VPN in standard mode; encrypted payloads remain encrypted without additional setup.

tools.name: Wireshark
tools.use_case: Investigate PCAPs from Android, a lab, or your own network.
tools.network: Offline PCAP reading can stay local; resolution features can generate lookups.
tools.limitation: Captures can contain session tokens and personal data; GitHub is a mirror of the upstream GitLab repository.

tools.name: Gitleaks
tools.summary: Local secret detection in files and Git history.
tools.use_case: Review code and research outputs before publication.
tools.network: Core scanning can run locally.
tools.limitation: A clean result is not proof that no credentials exist; exposed real secrets require rotation.

tools.name: ExifCleaner
tools.use_case: Clean sharing copies of supported image and media files.
tools.network: Processes files locally.
tools.limitation: PDF metadata removal is reversible; preserve originals and inspect output separately.

tools.name: Slips
tools.use_case: Evaluate unusual behavior in saved lab captures.
tools.network: Processes network data; threat-intelligence integrations may query external services.
tools.limitation: Heuristic and ML alerts need investigation; start with known captures.

tools.name: Cisco MCP Scanner
tools.use_case: Review agent tools, prompts, resources, and server code.
tools.network: Static/local and external analysis engines have different data-sharing behavior.
tools.limitation: Check the chosen engine and configuration before including private tool or skill content.

tools.name: OWASP Juice Shop
tools.use_case: Practice web testing on a disposable local target.
tools.network: Runs a local web service; image pulls contact a container registry.
tools.limitation: Keep the published port on loopback; the application is deliberately vulnerable.
